description: Given the Schema Definition Language (SDL) of a single subgraph, transform it into a federation-ready schema and return the SDL string that the supergraph gateway retrieves through the federation service-discovery query. The returned SDL preserves the subgraph's own object types, fields and applied federation directives (the key/entity, ownership and composition directives), normalizes type and field ordering, exposes a single root query type, and intentionally omits the internal federation plumbing types and the service-discovery fields themselves. Subgraphs written against either the first-generation directive set or the link-imported second-generation specification are both accepted.
